heiman-fall-detection.advice: Install it indoors only and follow the height and orientation in the manual. Choose an unobstructed position covering the resident’s living area; the product sheet advertises 4 × 4 m on a wall and 4 × 5 m on the ceiling. Élise supports caregiver vigilance; fall detection does not replace telecare or a human check-in.
features: Fall states reported over Zigbee: normal, fall warning or fall alarm
Wall or ceiling mounting, for indoor use only
Advertised range: 4 × 4 m on a wall or 4 × 5 m on the ceiling
heiman-fall-detection.name: Zigbee Fall Detection Sensor
placement: Install it indoors only and follow the height and orientation in the manual.
Choose an unobstructed position covering the resident’s living area; the product sheet advertises 4 × 4 m on a wall and 4 × 5 m on the ceiling.
Élise supports caregiver vigilance; fall detection does not replace telecare or a human check-in.
preparation: The retailer lists HS2FD-E; Zigbee2MQTT documents variant HS2FD-EF1-3.0. Ask the seller to confirm the exact reference before buying.
Connect the sensor to a 5 V / 2 A power supply near the Élise hub.
In Élise OS, choose “Install this sensor” and then Zigbee. Put the sensor in pairing mode using its manual; no Heiman hub or account is required.
After installation, verify a fall alert using the manufacturer’s test mode. This model has not yet been physically tested with Élise.

heiman-smoke-detector.advice: Mount it in the location and orientation required by the manual and applicable housing rules. Keep the detector unobstructed and accessible for testing; do not paint or cover it.
features: Photoelectric smoke detection and built-in siren ≥ 85 dB at 3 m
Zigbee2MQTT exposes smoke, test and battery (0–100%) states; Élise receives smoke and battery level

heiman-smoke-detector.name: Smart Zigbee smoke detector
placement: Mount it in the location and orientation required by the manual and applicable housing rules.
Keep the detector unobstructed and accessible for testing; do not paint or cover it.
preparation: Check the HS1SA-E reference: standalone and Z-Wave Heiman variants are not compatible with Élise Zigbee setup.
Install a CR123A battery, then bring the detector near the Élise hub.
In Élise OS, choose “Install this sensor” and then Zigbee. Use a paper clip to hold the side button for more than 2 seconds until the LED flashes rapidly.
It joins Élise OS over Zigbee via Zigbee2MQTT; no Heiman account, app or hub is required.
Keep the detector awake by pressing its button every 2 seconds until pairing is complete.

After installation, test the siren as described in the manual and check the detector and battery status in Élise. Zigbee2MQTT reports that some firmware versions can send repeated false smoke states; monitor it after pairing.
The detector has its own local siren. Élise notifications provide additional awareness and have not yet been validated on physical hardware.

note.check-baudrate: The speed depends on the installed firmware: check it if the key does not answer.
note.check-radio: Check that the Zigbee radio is enabled in the key’s own page.
note.discouraged-cc2531: Old model: little memory (about twenty devices at most). A more recent key is recommended.
note.experimental: Experimental support: correct operation is not guaranteed.
note.gpio-uart: Board plugged on the Raspberry Pi pins: it is not detected by itself, use the advanced mode.
note.keep-firmware-current: Keep the key’s firmware up to date for better performance.
note.multi-port: This board exposes several ports: take the first one.
note.ncp-firmware: This key must run the Zigbee firmware (not Thread or multiprotocol) to work with Élise.
note.network-adapter: Network key: set it to Zigbee coordinator mode and give it a fixed IP address.
note.old-generation: Old generation of key: a recent one is recommended.
note.usb3-extension: Plug the key on a USB extension cable to keep it away from the box: range is better and interference weaker.
